section: SECTION 1: SCIENTIFIC PURPOSE AND BIOLOGICAL SEMANTICS
question: What types of complex genetic variants were introduced for calling in Phase 3?
reference_answer: Phase 3 introduced multi-allelic variant calling.  This encompasses single nucleotide polymorphisms (SNPs), insertions/deletions (INDELs), and complex structural variants (SVs).
